#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <set>

int main() {
    int n, m;
    std::cin >> n >> m;
    std::vector<unsigned long> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    int half = n / 2;
    std::vector<unsigned long> part1, part2;

    // Compute sums for part1
    std::function<void(int, unsigned long)> compute_sums_part1 = [&](int i, unsigned long current_sum) {
        if (i == half) {
            part1.push_back(current_sum);
        } else {
            compute_sums_part1(i + 1, (current_sum + a[i]) % m);
            compute_sums_part1(i + 1, current_sum);
        }
    };

    // Compute sums for part2
    std::function<void(int, unsigned long)> compute_sums_part2 = [&](int i, unsigned long current_sum) {
        if (i == n) {
            part2.push_back(current_sum);
        } else {
            compute_sums_part2(i + 1, (current_sum + a[i]) % m);
            compute_sums_part2(i + 1, current_sum);
        }
    };

    compute_sums_part1(0, 0);
    compute_sums_part2(half, 0);

    // Remove duplicates and sort part1
    std::set<unsigned long> set_part1(part1.begin(), part1.end());
    std::vector<unsigned long> part1_unique_sorted(set_part1.begin(), set_part1.end());

    unsigned long best_total = 0;
    for (auto val : part2) {
        auto it = std::lower_bound(part1_unique_sorted.begin(), part1_unique_sorted.end(), m - val);
        if (it != part1_unique_sorted.begin()) {
            auto index = it - part1_unique_sorted.begin();
            unsigned long total_candidate = part1_unique_sorted[index - 1] + val;
            if (total_candidate > best_total) {
                best_total = total_candidate;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << best_total << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
